plugins.name: rankedin
plugins.description: Understand where you stand professionally and decide what to do next. Get direction on your next career move, a job search that isn't working, changing careers, AI changing your job, or building your professional reputation — right away, with no upload. Add your own LinkedIn data export for personal profile scores, strengths and gaps, peer comparison, AI resilience and network insight.

skills.name: next-career-move
skills.description: Help the user decide what to do next in their career with rankedin. Use when they say they feel stuck, need a change, don't know what to do next, or aren't sure what their next move should be; when they ask what their next career move should be, where to start when they need a job, why their job search isn't working, or whether to stay in their field or change careers; when they're worried about how AI will affect their career or AI is changing their job; or when they want to decide what to focus on next, build their professional reputation, become more visible in their industry, or win more customers through their professional presence. Works before any upload, using what the user shares plus rankedin's career paths; adds findings from their own rankedin analysis when one exists. Not for writing resumes or cover letters, finding job listings, interview practice or salary negotiation.
headings: Next career move — "help me decide what to do"
4. Deepen with their analysis, only when it exists and only where it helps
skills.description_zh: 借助rankedin职业路径及用户提供信息规划下一步，处理停滞、转行、求职方向、AI影响和专业声誉；无上传也可使用，有本人分析时补充结果。不写简历求职信、不找职位，也不做面试或薪酬谈判。

skills.name: profile-review
skills.description: Assess the user's own professional profile with rankedin. Use when they ask to analyze or review their LinkedIn profile, how strong their profile is, what their strengths or biggest gaps are, how they compare with peers or people like them, how AI resilient they are, how strong their professional network is, what to improve first, whether their professional positioning is strong or ready for a job search, or which of their real strengths their resume should emphasize. Personal results come only from the user's own rankedin analysis of their LinkedIn data export. If they have no analysis yet, explain what is missing and offer help deciding what to do next, which needs no upload.
headings: Pick the tools the question needs
When a tool has nothing to return
skills.description_zh: 用用户本人LinkedIn导出数据的rankedin分析评估专业档案、优势缺口、同行比较、AI韧性、网络和定位；个人结果只来自本人分析，无分析时说明缺少资料并可协助无需上传的下一步规划。
